releaseName: Economy runs get their writer's full budget
summary: A new run on the Economy pair now always uses the Economy writer's profile, even when the workspace or application never saved a model pair. Before, such a run reached the writer with a small default output limit and a small evidence budget: it fell back to retrieval and could stop at the writer's output limit on every attempt. A run that names its own pair keeps it.
knownLimitations: Inviting people to a team still goes through the API or an operator; the account menu does not list the team's people yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite. The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The legal pages show placeholder publisher details until the deployment sets them. Deleting an account from the screen works only for a person alone in their organisation; a team owner asks an operator. The readable copy does not yet include the career interview or research briefs.
